description: Issue #857: re-adds [Public] (IAllowAnonymous) to the demo FileApiController's DownloadFile action -- a compile-preserving attribute add, not a statement delete -- reproducing the pre-#830 state where any unauthenticated caller could download another tenant's FileAttachment content by GUID. This action's HTTP coverage was one of the four docs/production-readiness.md:67 claimed existed but did not: FileApiControllerHardeningTests830.cs had zero test methods for DownloadFile before #857. Checked against the new DownloadFile_Unauthenticated_RejectedAndDoesNotLeakContent_AuthenticatedSucceeds, which seeds a FileAttachment whose CONTENT embeds a random marker and asserts both that an unauthenticated GET returns 401 AND that the response body never contains the marker.
target_symbol: FileApiController.DownloadFile(WtmFileProvider,string,string) -- the [Public] attribute (absent after #830, this mutant re-adds it), line ~240

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Api.Test.FileApiControll: #857/#830: an unauthenticated caller must get 401 from DownloadFile \(the endpoint was \[Public\] before #830\)\. Got 200\.

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Captured against a clean checkout (stale demo.db under bin/ removed first) with the mutant patch applied via test/mutants/run_mutant.py: VERDICT: KILLED, matched pattern against the actual DownloadFile 401-vs-200 assertion failure.
